name: structural-format-structure
body: Each text format the structural scanner claims emits its structure as graph nodes under the format's `lang_switch` id, not just a `File` node: Markdown → heading `Struct`s (unchanged); shell → functions; YAML → keys/jobs/steps; JSON → keys; TOML → tables and keys; XML → elements; Dockerfile → stages and `FROM`/`RUN`/`COPY`/`ENV` instructions; Makefile → targets, variables and includes; INI → sections and keys. The residual `misc` format emits `File` only. Structure depth is deliberately minimal but useful — top-level keys/jobs/steps, tables/keys, elements, stages/instructions — not a full parse tree. Acceptance: a scan of a repository containing one file of each format emits the named structure for each.
